description:
Add a configurable, pluggable visit summary PDF export to openmrs-module-patientdocuments. When a patient moves between facilities or visits a community health worker, clinicians can print a one-page structured summary of the visit.
Each section (vitals, diagnoses, allergies, etc.) activates based on an Initializer config key. Any external module can contribute its own section by implementing the VisitSummarySection interface, with no changes required to patientdocuments core.
Sections included:
Facility header + patient info

Vitals (configurable concept UUIDs)

Diagnoses, Conditions, Allergies

Medications, Lab Results, Visit Notes

Frontend print button in the O3 patient chart
